cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 73% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +1.67%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.33%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: EOSE is the standout at +4.42%
cards.body: Leaders: EOSE +4.42%, VRT +2.68%, NXE +2.29%, GEV +2.14%, SEDG +1.89%. Laggards: BEP -1.89%, DUK -0.65%, NRG -0.56%, NEE -0.50%.
